agent_note: Third-person limited on Maya throughout, with two structurally distinct time strands carried in different tenses. The present-tense event quotes cluster on the younger-Maya/Frank/cabin material (acid trip, packing for college, the kiss, Aubrey, the cabin, the prologue at the ruined foundation); the past-tense event quotes cluster on the older, present-day storyline (withdrawal, Klonopin brunches, 'seven years apart', 'The Frank she knew', college backstory). So the split is a strand split, not noise and not diary form — the flashback strand is narrated simultaneously and the frame strand retrospectively. Recorded as 'dual' on that basis; a human applying label.py's SPLIT_REVIEW should record cause = strand. Quotation marks survived in only 1 of 27 quotes (q08159), so all other dialogue was assigned from vocatives, second-person address, and conversational discourse markers, recorded per quote; note the book also contains first-person spoken-testimony passages (q08143, q08153, q08160) distinct from the third-person narration. Flip-risk quotes: q08148, q08141, q08165.
